methods.name: GetLoginSalt
methods.comment: Login pass-through (identical semantics to the original Gen1/Gen2 web service login surface)

methods.name: CallG2Procedure
methods.comment:
Generic G2 (Gen2 REST) procedure passthrough. The procedure name is resolved strictly
 against the server-owned G2ProcedureCatalog (all 110 deployed G2 web-service procedures).
 Business failures are carried in the response fields (result/err_number/description),
 not as gRPC status errors. Gateway-level failures (unknown procedure, missing session,
 policy-blocked write, transport failure) use gRPC status codes.

methods.name: CallG1Procedure
methods.comment:
Generic, catalog-governed SOAP passthrough to the deployed OBERON G1 web services
 against the server-owned G1ProcedureCatalog (all 166 documented G1 procedures:
 92 IOBERONService + 61 IOBERONCashRegisterService + 13 IOBERONLoyaltySystemService).
 Business failures are carried in the response fields (result/err_number/description),
 not as gRPC status errors. Gateway-level failures (unknown procedure, missing session,
 blocked policy gate, transport fault) are raised as gRPC status errors.

methods.name: ListG1Procedures
methods.comment:
Introspection of the server-owned G1 procedure catalog (documentation surface for
 GET /api/g1/procedures; gateway-local, no backend call).

methods.name: CallCRG2Procedure
methods.comment:
Generic CashRegister-Gen2 (IOBERONServiceCashRegisterGen2 REST) procedure passthrough.
 The procedure name is resolved strictly against the server-owned CRG2ProcedureCatalog
 (96 deployed CashRegister-Gen2 web-service procedures: 85 generic-callable + 11
 gateway-session-owned). Requires an authenticated CashRegister-Gen2 backend session
 (login with cashRegisterGen2PasswordHash, see GetLoginSalts.cashRegisterGen2Salt).
 Business failures are carried in the response fields (result/err_number/description),
 not as gRPC status errors. Gateway-level failures (unknown procedure, missing session,
 policy-blocked write, transport fault) use gRPC status codes.

methods.name: ListCRG2Procedures
methods.comment:
Introspection of the server-owned CashRegister-Gen2 procedure catalog (documentation
 surface; gateway-local, no backend call).

Exact G2 procedure name, e.g. "Stock_StockCard_Get". Case-sensitive; see docs/grpc-migration

fields.name: json_payload
fields.comment:
JSON object with the procedure arguments (field names documented per procedure).
 Empty string or "{}" means argument-less call (GET / no-body procedures only).

fields.name: result

G2 envelope result field: true = business success, false = business error
 (then err_number/description are set). Missing envelope field => false.

fields.name: err_number

fields.name: description
fields.comment: G2 envelope description (localizable error text when result=false).

fields.name: data_json
fields.comment: G2 envelope "data" member serialized as a JSON string ("null" when absent).

fields.name: transport_status
fields.comment: HTTP status code returned by the G2 REST endpoint (diagnostic only).

fields.name: procedure
json_payload
fields.comment:
JSON object whose keys are the DOCUMENTED parameter names of the procedure
 (scalars, DTOs by member name, arrays as JSON arrays). "{}" = argument-less call.
 The gateway maps this onto the SOAP envelope using the server-owned catalog ONLY;
 caller-supplied XML/actions/URLs are never possible.

fields.name: result
fields.comment:
G1 ResultValue envelope: true = business success, false = business error
 (then err_number/description are set). Missing envelope fields => false.

fields.name: err_number
fields.comment: G1 envelope errNumber (see enm_Err_Basic; 0 when result=true).

fields.name: description
fields.comment: G1 envelope description (localizable error text when result=false).

fields.name: data_json
fields.comment:
G1 envelope "data" member serialized as a JSON string ("null" when absent).
 Operations returning Stream carry {"base64": "..."} here.
 Operations with a bare (non-ResultValue) return are wrapped as {"value": "..."}.

fields.comment: Echo of the resolved catalog name (bare form, e.g. "GetLicences").

fields.name: transport_status
fields.comment: HTTP status code returned by the G1 SOAP endpoint (diagnostic only).

fields.comment: Optional substring filter on procedure names (case-insensitive).

fields.name: interface_filter

fields.name: exact_name
fields.comment: Optional EXACT procedure name (case-insensitive equality; used by GET /api/g1/procedures/{name}).

fields.name: interface_name
fields.comment: "IOBERONService" | "IOBERONCashRegisterService" | "IOBERONLoyaltySystemService".

fields.name: args

oberon.servicegateway.BackendTarget.comment:
Backend generation selector for dual-routed RPCs.
 UNSPECIFIED preserves status-quo routing (Gen1 for Stock). Selection NEVER re-routes implicitly:
 an unauthenticated requested backend fails explicitly (BackendNotAuthenticated).
